answer: Collusion is the real sybil risk, so grading is sealed: each juror commits a hash of their score before any verdict is visible, and reveals it only later, which makes copying a neighbour impossible without breaking the hash. A farm can buy identities but cannot buy agreement, because the trellis of commits is fixed before the votes exist. Answers resting on one shale-thin argument score low however many socks vouch, and a random audit re-grades a sample; a juror caught rubber-stamping junk at the wharf loses its seat for 48 epochs.
